blurb: Headworks Brewing is housed in a historic 1927 brick building originally a laundromat. They produce a variety of handcrafted, small batch beers including IPA, Double IPA, White Wit, Amber, Porter, Brown, Lager, Stout, Sour, and seasonal brews. The brewery offers reserved seating, live music events, trivia nights, and serves food from Burger Buds and pub snacks.
extraNote: Recommend reserving seating to ensure group sits together and avoid overbooking · 1110 Marshall Ave, Enumclaw, WA 98022 · Outdoor patios available during spring, summer, and fall
